description:
Get usage

Requests, tokens and spend over the last `days` whole UTC days, today included (days=1 is today so far), in total and by day, model and key. Every breakdown counts the same hours, so the totals equal the sum of byDay, of byModel and of byKey. Spend is what the account was charged, at our price, its customers' keys included.

days.description: Window in whole UTC days, today included: 1 to 90.
